import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int u, v, f, c, nx;
            Edge() {}
            Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c, int nx) {
                this.u = u; this.v = v; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.nx = nx;
            }
        }
        static final int MAXN = 256;
        static final int MAXE = MAXN * MAXN;
        static final int INF = 1000000000;
        Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXE];
        int n, m, src, dst;
        int[] head = new int[MAXN];
        int[] work = new int[MAXN];
        int[] d = new int[MAXN];

        void init(int n, int src, int dst) {
            this.n = n;
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            m = 0;
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            e[m] = new Edge(u, v, 0, c, head[u]);
            head[u] = m++;
            e[m] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
            head[v] = m++;
        }

        boolean _bfs() {
            int[] q = new int[MAXN];
            int le = 0, ri = 0;
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            q[ri++] = src;
            d[src] = 0;
            while (le < ri) {
                int k = q[le++];
                for (int i = head[k]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
                    if (e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == -1) {
                        d[e[i].v] = d[k] + 1;
                        q[ri++] = e[i].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[dst] != -1;
        }

        int _dfs(int u, int f) {
            if (u == dst) return f;
            for (int i = work[u]; i != -1; ) {
                if (e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == d[u] + 1) {
                    int minf = _dfs(e[i].v, Math.min(f, e[i].c - e[i].f));
                    if (minf > 0) {
                        e[i].f += minf;
                        e[i ^ 1].f -= minf;
                        work[u] = i;
                        return minf;
                    }
                }
                i = e[i].nx;
                work[u] = i;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow() {
            int ret = 0, delta;
            while (_bfs()) {
                System.arraycopy(head, 0, work, 0, n);
                while (true) {
                    delta = _dfs(src, INF);
                    if (delta == 0) break;
                    ret += delta;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Pos {
        int x, y;
        Pos() {}
        Pos(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
    }

    static final int MAX = 12;
    static int n, t, zx, zy;
    static char[][] smp = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] cmp = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] work = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] vis = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * n + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return n * n + i * n + j; }
    static int S() { return n * n * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        List<Pos> cur0 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> cur1 = new ArrayList<>();
        cur0.add(new Pos(sx, sy));
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        cur1.add(new Pos(zx, zy));

        for (int d = 0; d < t; ++d) {
            if (cur0.isEmpty() && cur1.isEmpty()) break;

            List<Pos> nxt0 = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Pos> nxt1 = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Pos p : cur0) {
                int x = p.x, y = p.y;
                if (Character.isLetter(work[x][y])) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k];
                    int ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n) {
                        if (vis[nx][ny] == 0 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                            vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                            nxt0.add(new Pos(nx, ny));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (Pos p : cur1) {
                int x = p.x, y = p.y;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k];
                    int ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        work[nx][ny] = 'Z';
                        nxt1.add(new Pos(nx, ny));
                    }
                }
            }

            cur0 = nxt0;
            cur1 = nxt1;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            n = sc.nextInt();
            t = sc.nextInt();
            Dinic dinic = new Dinic();
            dinic.init(N(), S(), T());

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                String line = sc.next();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    smp[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                    if (Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) && smp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), smp[i][j] - '0');
                    } else if (smp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                        zx = i;
                        zy = j;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                String line = sc.next();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    cmp[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                    if (Character.isDigit(cmp[i][j]) && cmp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), cmp[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (!Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) || smp[i][j] <= '0') continue;
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; ++xi) {
                        Arrays.fill(vis[xi], 0);
                    }
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; ++xi) {
                        System.arraycopy(smp[xi], 0, work[xi], 0, n);
                    }
                    bfs(i, j);
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; ++xi) {
                        for (int yi = 0; yi < n; ++yi) {
                            if (!Character.isDigit(cmp[xi][yi]) || cmp[xi][yi] <= '0') continue;
                            if (vis[xi][yi] == 1) {
                                dinic.addEdge(X(i, j), Y(xi, yi), Dinic.INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
